ValidationRule.description: Throws error if the Case changes to the Card Disputes - General Queue and the Record Type is not ATM Dispute or Card Dispute.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, AND( ISCHANGED(Queue__c), Owner:Queue.QueueName = 'Card Disputes - General Queue'), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName != 'ATM_Dispute', RecordType.DeveloperName != 'Card_Dispute') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For this Dispute Type, please select either Support Coach Queue or Digital Fraud Queue.
